title: Article 128 — Attendance of retired Judges at sittings of the Supreme Court

content.overview: Article 128 provides that the Chief Justice of India may at any time, with the previous consent of the President, request any person who has held the office of a Judge of the Supreme Court or of the Federal Court or who has held the office of a Judge of a High Court and is duly qualified for appointment as a Judge of the Supreme Court to sit and act as a Judge of the Supreme Court. Every such person so requested, while so sitting and acting, has all the jurisdiction, powers and privileges of a Judge of the Supreme Court and is bound by the duties of such a Judge, but is not otherwise deemed to be a Judge of the Supreme Court.
content.glance: CJI (with President’s consent) may request retired SC/Federal Court Judges or qualified former HC Judges to sit and act as SC Judges.
content.study:
Article 128 allows retired Judges (SC, Federal Court, or qualified former HC Judges) to sit and act as SC Judges on the request of the CJI with the previous consent of the President. While acting they have full powers and duties but are not otherwise deemed SC Judges.

Examination: who may be requested; CJI + President consent; powers while acting; not otherwise deemed a Judge.

sections.heading: Key rule
sections.body: CJI may, with previous consent of the President, request a former SC/Federal Court Judge or a former HC Judge qualified for SC appointment to sit and act as an SC Judge. Full powers while acting; not otherwise deemed an SC Judge.

questionsAndAnswers.question: Can retired Judges sit in the Supreme Court?
questionsAndAnswers.answer: Yes. Under Article 128, the Chief Justice of India may, with the previous consent of the President, request a person who has held office as a Judge of the Supreme Court or of the Federal Court, or who has held office as a High Court Judge and is duly qualified for appointment as a Supreme Court Judge, to sit and act as a Judge of the Supreme Court. While so acting, that person has all the jurisdiction, powers and privileges of an SC Judge but is not otherwise deemed to be a Judge of the Supreme Court.

examTips: Retired SC/FC/qualified HC Judges may sit on CJI request with President’s consent.

keyTakeaways: Art 128: retired Judges may sit and act as SC Judges on request.
